root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `s + 2 < end` must hold before `g_ascii_isxdigit (s[1])` may execute
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the percent-decoder guard, two lookahead bytes must still remain inside the current `[start, end)` span before the first hexadecimal validation read is allowed to execute.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable source validates `s[1]` and `s[2]` as hexadecimal digits without first enforcing the missing source-level bound `s + 2 < end`. The fixed source adds that conjunct and rejects a trailing `%` before the first lookahead read occurs.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: Vulnerable original: `percent_guard.second_hex_digit_ptr=0x6020000000d2` and `percent_guard.end=0x6020000000d1`, so the required predicate `s + 2 < end` is false while the protected `hex_lookahead` event still executes. Fixed original: the last guarded root event records `second_hex_digit_ptr=0x6020000001f2`, `end=0x6020000001f1`, and no `hex_lookahead`, so the obligation is guarded. The nearest valid witness `percent00_boundary` records `second_hex_digit_ptr=0x602000000252`, `end=0x602000000253`, and an executed `hex_lookahead`, giving the required genuine fixed-side witness.

nodes.state: At the first hexadecimal lookahead, the address of `s[1]` is already at or past `end`, so the sink dereference is outside the admitted one-byte span.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `hex_lookahead.first_hex_digit_ptr=0x6020000000d1` and `hex_lookahead.end=0x6020000000d1`, so the first `g_ascii_isxdigit (s[1])` read starts exactly at `end`, matching the one-byte heap-buffer-overflow report.

edges.relation: The same first lookahead address `s + 1` present at the missing bounds check is the address consumed unchanged by the first `g_ascii_isxdigit (s[1])` sink evaluation.
edges.evidence: In the vulnerable original, `percent_guard.first_hex_digit_ptr == hex_lookahead.first_hex_digit_ptr == 0x6020000000d1`; in the genuine `%00` witness, the last paired events record the same propagated value `0x602000000251` on both sides of the transition.

patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff carries the real `glib/guri.c` bounds fix but its `glib/tests/uri.c` hunk is out of sync with the staged vulnerable checkout, so `switch-fixed --patch` failed on the test file. Fixed-side validation therefore recreated the workspace from the authoritative `n132/arvo:42485335-fix` image, applied only the fixed instrumentation patch there, and verified that the repaired `s + 2 >= end` guard suppresses the protected lookahead on the original `%` witness while still allowing the nearest valid `%00` boundary case to execute the same source-level sink.
